<!-- pr-reviewer: 884e721967faa077fa146bdb7dcc7d9c58026005 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Assignment re-reads and re-validates at the front door (`machine/library.rs` `read_for_assign`, first refusal by name), shared by `LoadMachine::from_catalogue`, `SetSetupMachine::from_catalogue` and the UI route, so a refused machine cannot mount even if the command is queued directly.
- The UI route (`state_setup_mount.rs` `mount_catalogue`) goes through the existing `route_machine(MachineVerb::Mount)` from #471: the active setup's own machine is replaced via `SetSetupMachine`, otherwise `LoadMachine`. One undo step either way; the pane itself only queues a command (no ad-hoc field writes, layering ui -> app respected).
- Disabled button states carry the reason ("fails validation - ... (and N more)", "already this setup's machine"). The `unwrap`/`expect` calls in the diff are all in tests. Provenance and decision file present; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #384`; no CHANGELOG.md edit; no deps, build.rs, scripts or .github changes.

**Local results (PR head, up to date with upstream/main, no conflicts, debug, macOS)**

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `machine_assign` | 3 passed |
| app `machine_library` | 11 passed |
| app `machine` | 32 passed |
| app `setup_mount` | 6 passed |
| app `setup_mounts_post` | 5 passed |
| app `machine_edit` | 12 passed |
| ui lib `machine` filter | 30 passed |
| ui `tests/machine` | 6 passed |
| clippy app+ui `--all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- The PR is not a draft (the body says draft until the GUI check; the contributor's later comment reports the hands-on check passed).
- Ctrl+Y redo is covered only at app level, and the disabled-hover text is not asserted; both fine for now.
- `crates/ui/src/state.rs` is ~3900 lines (already far over ~400); this PR adds 7. Not blocking.
- The PR says it is stacked on #382; that is already in main, so nothing to wait for.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
